title: NCR Voyix Recognized as the #1 Global POS Software Provider for the 10th Consecutive Year
summary: The decade of recognition from Datos Insights reflects both the scale of the NCR Voyix global footprint and the long-term nature of its relationships with enterprise retailers and restaurants around the world.
body_markdown:
ATLANTA--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- **November 18, 2026** --[NCR Voyix](https://htttps//www.ncrvoyix.com) (NYSE: VYX), a platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining, today announced that it has been recognized as the world’s #1 provider of point-of-sale (POS) software for the 10th year in a row, according to[Datos Insights’ Global POS Software 2026 study](https://datos-insights.com/what-we-offer/market-data-forecasting/retail-technology/global-pos-software/) .


NCR Voyix maintained its position as the #1 global POS software provider by installed base, with 14% global market share . The company retained its #1 position in Grocery+ , increasing its global share in the segment from 17% to 18%. NCR Voyix also ranked #1 in Western Europe and #1 globally in Restaurants. In addition, Datos Insights recognized the company as the world’s leading supplier of self-checkout technology in its recently released[Global EPOS and Self-Checkout 2026 study](https://datos-insights.com/what-we-offer/market-data-forecasting/retail-technology/global-epos-and-self-checkout/) .


The decade of recognition from Datos Insights reflects both the scale of the NCR Voyix global footprint and the long-term nature of its relationships with enterprise retailers and restaurants around the world. Since the study began, NCR Voyix has maintained the leading global installed base even as commerce has evolved significantly, from the growth of digital and mobile experiences to increasingly connected store and restaurant operations.


“Receiving third-party validation for the 10th consecutive year that we are the world’s leading POS software provider is a meaningful milestone and a reflection of the trust our customers place in NCR Voyix,” said James G. Kelly, Chief Executive Officer, NCR Voyix. “We are building on that foundation with the Voyix Commerce Platform, helping retailers and restaurants modernize their technology, connect their operations and innovate faster. Our scale and experience give us a unique opportunity to help customers turn their technology modernization strategies into measurable impact.”


NCR Voyix serves many of the world’s leading retailers and restaurants, providing software and services that support critical commerce operations across stores, restaurants and digital channels. The company is unifying those capabilities through the[Voyix Commerce Platform](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/platform) , creating a more open and connected foundation that helps customers simplify their technology environments, rapidly deploy new capabilities and deliver more consistent experiences.


“The global POS software market continues to evolve as retailers and hospitality businesses expand the number and types of transaction touchpoints while evaluating more flexible, cloud-based technology architectures,” said Chris Allen, Research Manager, Datos Insights. “NCR Voyix has a strong position in the market, particularly across North America and Europe, and has the leading share of the global installed base.”


The Datos Insights Global POS Software study provides a comprehensive view of the global POS software market, analyzing new and existing projects involving 1,000 or more POS installations at retail and hospitality enterprises across 48 global markets and eight industry subsegments.


**About NCR Voyix**


NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide. For more information, visit[ncrvoyix.com](https://www.ncrvoyix.com/) .
